resCmpData.re_desc_note_fin: 1.The above results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at the respective meetings held on May 29, 2024 and May 30, 2024, respectively.   2.These Standalone Financial results have been prepared in accordance with Companies (Indian Accounting Standards), Rules, 2015 (as amended) under section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013.   3.Figures of last quarter are the balancing figures between audited figures in respect of the full financial year and published (regrouped) year to date figures upto the 3rd Quarter of the current financial year.   4.During the second half of this financial year, the Company received communication from the banks regarding classification of credit exposure of the Company as Substandard pursuant to RBI divergence report. The Company enjoys fund based (Rs.1398 crs) and non fund based (Rs.2358 crs) limits from 12 banks amounting to Rs.3756 crs. Out of this, 9 banks have classified the account as NPA amounting to Rs.3399 crs .   5.During the second half of this financial year, the Company has accounted for termination/short closure of certain contracts and revision of project budget which has impacted the turnover. Total shortclosure/termination of contracts is amounting to Rs.479758 lakhs during the year.   6.Bank guarantees encashed by clients amonting to Rs.36241 lakhs which form part of other current asset and the Company has initiated arbitration proceedings. Subsequently, till 29.05.2024 further 4 clients encashed BG valuing Rs.129336 lakhs.   7.The promoters have infused funds in the form of Unsecured loan. The Company is taking efforts for debt restructuring and infusion of strategic investor. The Company is making all efforts of implementing a restructuring plan and therefore the accounts of the Company has been prepared on  Going concern basis .   8.The income from operations includes claim settlement of Rs.663 crs received from a customer. Provision of Rs.550 crs was accounted in third quarter. Based on agreeement reached with counter parties the cost has been finalised as Rs.190 crs resulting in reversal of provision to the extent of Rs.360 crs during this quarter. Consequently this being an adjusting event relating to the reporting period, the cost of material is adjusted during the quarter.   9.Pursuant to the orders of the The Honourable Rajasthan High court on 21.12.2023, the Company received demand notice from the Rajasthan VAT authorities amounting to Rs.508.69 crs (Tax Rs.145.52 crs and Interest Rs.363.17 crs) on 12.01.2024. SLP has been filed in Supreme court on 29.04.2024.   10.The figures for the previous period have been regrouped/rearranged wherever necessary to conform to the current period's classification.
